name: A
purpose: fast evolution set; the Optimizer sees these questions, their transcripts and their cards
note: The five round-12 questions. They are typical of their categories and both lanes already have judged v1 output on them, which makes the first bootstrap comparable with the round-12 record. Replace a question only by rotating it out (see README 8); never edit its text in place, the cache keys include it. `topicWords` is the curated list the topicality lint rejects in a challenger's added text (stems and inflections are matched); `candidateTopicWords()` in runner/lint.ts proposes candidates for a new question, a person prunes them once. `intent` is informational; `type` (decision | exploratory) is what the evaluator reads.

questions.label: Skincare troubleshooting
questions.text: I started three new skincare products last week and now my face stings. How do I figure out what’s causing it?

questions.label: Career tradeoff
questions.text: I got an offer that pays 25% more, but the commute would be 90 minutes each way. How do I decide whether it’s worth it?

questions.label: One-sided friendship
questions.text: I’m always the one making plans with my friend. When we meet, it’s lovely, but if I stop texting, nothing happens. Should I say something?

questions.label: Comparison and expectations
questions.text: Most of my friends are buying homes or getting married. I’m not sure I even want those things, but I still feel behind.

questions.label: Geography and causation
questions.text: Why are some places in northern Europe warmer in winter than parts of Canada at similar latitudes?
